author: WingXCustom
quote:
13 Years for this crap? This is the same game as every GTA before it only with a prettier coat of paint and way more bugs. 

This series hasn't tried to innovate since GTA3. Games like Saints Row 1-3 and Sleeping Dogs tried harder than this crap.

Not to mention it's a 30FPS relationship sim with dips into 15-20FPS? What is this, 2013!?

On top of that 2K games is trying to push the price of games to $80-$100 after having just pushed them to $70 at the start of this Generation with NBA 2K? Nah. F@#& that. We need to vote with our wallets!
